name: Button
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One isolated transparent PNG reference sprite for a scale-of-universe explorer. Subject: one small round clothing button made of matte ivory plastic, with exactly four sewing holes through the center, a gently raised rim, oblique macro view. A garment fastener, no switch, no mechanism, no metal base. Detailed realistic object illustration, entire subject centered in frame with a small transparent margin. Genuine alpha transparency outside the object and through every opening. No background rectangle, no cast shadow, no backdrop, no text, no labels, no watermark.
